title: ZEX-P2P
tagline: ZEX is a confidential Peer-to-peer decentralized exchange where you can trade with privacy
description:
ZEX is a confidential Peer-to-peer decentralized exchange where you can convert any ERC20 to a ERC7984 and trade without revealing amount to anyone. it is built using ZAMA'S FHE encryption technology and using the Openzeppelin's standard implementation of ERC7984. 
ZEX unlocks a whole new possibility of trading at your rate in a quantity that no one can seen by using FHE encryption. unlocking privacy along with ethereum's transparency is the future!!
how_its_made:
This project implements a peer-to-peer decentralized exchange (DEX) for confidential asset swaps using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) on Ethereum. It leverages Zama’s FHE technology and relayer SDK to enable private trading of ERC20-like tokens, ensuring that sensitive trade amounts remain encrypted and only visible to authorized parties. 
we index all the events using envio's indexer to ensure the complete workflow
